text: INTERPRETER taint hooks on the sealed instantiation only (eval_t::<true>): a block restores the accumulator between statements; let, refinement-predicate and pattern bindings carry the value's taint; assignments (plain, in place, place writes) store it with the pc/sticky control taint; comparisons read operands deep and untype, with no in-place operand read; &&/|| through short_circuit_tainted; if/match/while/while-let/for/select branch under t_branch; return and ? set the return taint (? also sticky); fmt-strings, channel send, handler arms (abortable count, payload and return-arm taint), native calls (World) and builtin dispatch (t_builtin_in, pc guard, t_builtin_out). dispatch_named, dispatch_call, match_pattern, bind_let, chan_method and assign_in_place become const-generic, the bytecode engine passing VM_SEALED=false. Unsealed runs: the T=false instantiation is main's code; behaviour unchanged; not PCI-reviewed; every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
